explication: This monorepo lets people use ChatGPT OAuth credentials in apps and OpenAI-compatible clients. The main hosted-app flow is sign-in, credential forwarding, then a chat or image request through an SDK provider to OpenAI. A separate local flow reads Codex credentials and serves compatible API routes; the CLI manages that server. The README also documents browser extensions and client adapters. Sampled source supports the server, credential, and transport links; unsampled package internals are represented by their exact tree paths, with uncertain wiring omitted.
